title: Liquid glass floating toolbar
blurb: One WebGL 2 canvas floats a translucent glass capsule dock over a live scrollable HTML feed, bending passing cards along an analytic capsule bevel while keeping both layers clickable.
question: Can one ElementGL WebGL 2 canvas refract and magnify a live scrollable HTML feed through a bevelled floating glass capsule dock while keeping controls on both layers clickable?
result: Measured in headless Chrome 160 Canary (2026-11-27): 6/6 live checks pass (948x1361, 1.29 MP, 10.3 MB live at 412 px DPR 2.625); capsule bevel refraction differs by 69.5/ch from flat frosted glass with |R-B| = 116 chromatic split, and both moved dock tabs and scrolling feed buttons stay clickable via updateElementGeometry(). Real Android Chrome 159 and npm run check:jank stay not verified.
